Governing text: `docs/adr/0084` § 概览 Overview `#amendment-2026-11-26-overview`, on main. It is binding for this card: the thin build is Info (read-only, technical fields folded away) plus Pending, with the ⋯ menu moved from the top bar with its six rows as they are today. Question 1 is ruled B (record 7187264388): disable, enable and delete stay in Setup and get no second home here, and "Manage in Setup" is a row. There is no `package` metadata type. Pending counts the open package's drafts; the badge on 概览 is drawn only while something is pending.
Serial constraints cleared: #37455 has merged. Open PR #37501 (OWD overview Save) touches Studio save code, not the overview, the menu model or the draft panel; whichever lands second rebases. #37520 (this area, same round) owns `PageShell.tsx` and new test files only. #37456 waits for this card.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:ui`; every path is under `ui/packages`.
Pre-claim deps: the card's `Blocked-by: #37451` is closed (merged).
Prior rulings read: the amendment above; epic #36510 (a person's Save goes live, AI drafts publish per package); ADR-0146 D1 and D3; the maintainer's 「按推荐启动」; the Q1 = B record 7187264388.
